notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Halloween Update
This content update brings a number of new features to the game right in time for Halloween! 
*Burst fire system item allows burst fire mode to be toggled on the gun
*Atmospheric effects are tweaked to be more realistic
*Enemy adjustments to make combat more exciting
*Ammo cap is now set so you cannot carry more than 80 bullets
*New events occurring in the world
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34806710/2ab5521ef0076e9ac5f4b93050a562f12bfb4770.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 7 - Challenge update
notes.content:
This is a big update to the game, making it more challenging to complete.
This version is incompatible with previous save games.

Here is a complete changelog:

- Existing enemy types effects tweaks, and enhancements
- New environmental effects
- Increase performance
- 6 new enemy types, 3 are tough boss like creatures
- Fixed Worm water based attacks
- Increased bat hitbox size
- More Ammo boxes in the later areas
- Lots of minor tweaks

tags.feature: - 6 new enemy types, 3 are tough boss like creatures

tags.balance_change: - More Ammo boxes in the later areas

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
The game was updated again. 
- Fixed the humanoid shark movements.
- Less ammo per pickup 16 bullets down to 8. Need to be more careful with how you spend your rounds. 
- The squid enemy appearance changed to animate more
- Some optimization on game performance

tags.balance_change: - Less ammo per pickup 16 bullets down to 8.

tags.feature: - The squid enemy appearance changed to animate more

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Hello, in this update the following was added/changed in the game:

- Add notice for quick change weapon
- Flashlight battery will decrease slower
- Crocodile will roam more near the mask statue
- Shark people will be more active
- Jumping Spider shouldn't get so close with his jumps

tags.feature: - Add notice for quick change weapon

tags.balance_change: - Crocodile will roam more near the mask statue
- Shark people will be more active
- Jumping Spider shouldn't get so close with his jumps

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Y - Axis invert is now an option in the General settings section of the in-game Pause Menu. 

This will be set by default to on when you launch the first time after the update so toggle it off if you do not want an inverted Y axis.
